title: Cortist Reality Ledger: Initial Public Evidence Snapshot (v1.0)
description:
Versioned, source-linked editorial evidence register of ten consequential artificial-intelligence claims, announcements and published findings. The 25 October 2026 snapshot preserves ten original dated JSON evidence records (CL-0001–CL-0010) and a normalized JSONL export linking to twelve original primary-source references. Each record separates the tracked question, documented evidence, explicit limitations and next evidence trigger. This is not independent ground-truth labeling, a safety certification, a company ranking or a validated outcome score.

Cortist-authored materials are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) to the extent Cortist owns the relevant rights. Linked third-party research and other external works are excluded and subject to their original rights. Canonical records and subsequent versions: Cortist Reality Ledger. Another discoverable distribution: Hugging Face.
